# Enumeration: AdvectionMethod

Advection methods for transporting gas fields through the velocity grid.

## Enumeration Members

<a id="maccormack"></a>

### MacCormack

```ts
MacCormack: "MacCormack";
```

Higher-order MacCormack advection with correction to limit numerical diffusion.

### SemiLagrangian

